newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNCC says eyes new infrastructure projects.
newsitem.headline: PNCC says eyes new infrastructure projects.

text.p: The Philippine National Construction Corp (PNCC) said on Thursday it was considering eight new infrastructure projects in the country.

PNCC told the Philippine Stock Exchange that it had submitted its prequalification documents for the 25-billion peso Metro Manila Strategic Mass Rail Transit Development project, the 350-million peso Vargas flyover, the 54-million peso Marikina-Infanta road, and the 500 million peso Asian Development Bank-assisted Sixth Road Project.
The company also said that it had initiated studies on the feasibility of the Laiban Dam project, the R-5 road project, the Northrail Transit station and the seven-kilometre Quezon canal.

The PNCC also said it had been tapped by the Citra Metro Manila Tollways Corp to undertake the rehabilitation of the at-grade level of the elevated tollway. The initial cost has been estimated at 275 million pesos.
